_comment: Places to buy one specific thing. No menu: walk up, the game's own prompt appears
top left, press the key, eat it.
item        an id from foods.json. That is where the price and the hunger live.
label       what the prompt calls it. Defaults to the item's name.
x, y, z     where it is. z is the GROUND; anything spawned is placed on the
ground properly, so being a little out is harmless.
heading     which way a spawned stand faces, 0-360.
reach       how close you have to be to buy, in metres.
item        one id, a list of ids, or a list of { id, from, to } with hours.
An entry with no hours is on the board all day and is what a shop
falls back to. That is how the diner serves breakfast 5-11 and a
plate the rest of the time. Several available at once = random.
fromVehicle true lets you order without getting out -- a drive-through. The
car has to be nearly stopped, and reach wants to be bigger,
because you are measured from the driver seat.
spawnRange  how close before anything is created at all.
hours       open and close, as hours of the day. Outside them the WHOLE pitch
is gone -- a cart standing there all night that cannot be bought
from looks broken, not closed. Omit for always open.
smoke       everyHours is GAME hours between cigarettes; seconds is REAL
seconds spent on one. Each unit measures what it should: how often
he goes is his working day, how long you watch him is watching.
back is how far behind his post he wanders. He will not serve
while he is away.
prop / ped  OPTIONAL candidate lists. Leave them out entirely for a place that
already exists in the world -- a serving hatch, a restaurant door --
and nothing is spawned; it becomes just a spot with a price.
Where they ARE given, the first model that exists in your build wins
and every miss is named in BareMinimum.log.
blipSprite  52 is Store, the shopping bag. CHECK ANY NUMBER YOU PUT HERE: a
sprite the game does not have draws the default dot rather than
nothing, and a wrong one draws the WRONG icon -- 267 is Property
Management and 106 is the FIB, both of which look deliberate.
To add your own: stand where you want it, read the coordinates off a coord HUD,
and copy a block below.
ui        show the shelf menu. ONLY where there is somebody to order from:
a shop you walk into with a cashier. A door on the street gets the
one-key prompt and one item instead.
discount  what fraction of the marked price this place charges. 1 is normal.

vendors._note2: half a kilometre west, which is a bar and sells small plates. Same sign
vendors._note3: as the two downtown liqour.delis, so the same stock. NO DISCOUNT: its
vendors._note4: windows say CASH CHECKS HERE, not the closing-down signage those two got.
vendors.name: Eclipse Liquor & Deli

vendors._note: Bean Machine on West Vinewood, the fifth branch and the first one
vendors._note2: north of the freeway. IDENTICAL STOCK to the other four: it is the same
vendors._note3: chain, and a coffee shop selling something different in one suburb would
vendors._note4: read as a mistake. The bm_ items sell the SLEEP meter, not the hunger one.
vendors.name: Bean Machine

vendors._note: CHIDO!, Del Perro. The awning reads TAQUERIA MEXICANA under the name,
vendors._note2: and the tiled band along the bottom of the window is the same yellow and
vendors._note3: red as the sign. A sit-down taqueria rather than a hatch, so it carries a
vendors._note4: plate as well as the street tacos. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Chido!

vendors._note: LAS CUADRAS DELI, Del Perro, at the foot of the tiled building. Stocked
vendors._note2: from the SHARED deli counter like Del-Hi and Gabrielle's rather than given
vendors._note3: items of its own: it is a deli counter, not a brand with a menu, and the
vendors._note4: named-item treatment is for a sign that promises something specific.
vendors.name: Las Cuadras Deli

vendors._note: THE GRAIN OF TRUTH, Del Perro. ORGANIC FOOD MARKET on the band under the
vendors._note2: wheat-sheaf logo. NO CIGARETTES AND NO FIZZY DRINK -- a shop selling
vendors._note3: Redwood next to the wheatgrass is a different joke, and a worse one. Milk
vendors._note4: and water are the only things off the general shelf. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: The Grain of Truth

vendors._note: THE DICKIES BAGELS & DELI, Del Perro, under the freeway. The bagel is
vendors._note2: the shop and the deli is the other half, so it carries both: three of its
vendors._note3: own and the shared deli sandwich. Coffee because a bagel shop that has no
vendors._note4: coffee is not one. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: The Dickies Bagels & Deli

vendors._note: WIGWAM, Del Perro. Its whole menu is painted across the windows, so the
vendors._note2: shelf is simply what the glass says: the special, the burger, the soup,
vendors._note3: the wings and the rings. Door coordinate, on the corner.
vendors.name: Wigwam

vendors._note: Bean Machine, Del Perro. The sixth branch. Same stock as the other five,
vendors._note2: for the same reason: one chain, one menu.
vendors.name: Bean Machine

vendors._note: ROB'S LIQUOR, Del Perro. A WALK-IN, so the coordinate is the COUNTER
vendors._note2: INSIDE rather than the door -- that is where you buy, and a shelf on the
vendors._note3: pavement outside a shop you can walk into is the wrong place for it. The
vendors._note4: vendor also wins the interact key off the generic prop-found counter.
vendors.name: Rob's Liquor

vendors._note: BITE!, Del Perro. The third branch, and the only one with the Gut Buster
vendors._note2: poster in the window -- see bite_gutbuster. Otherwise the chain's wraps.
vendors.name: BITE!

vendors._note: Chihuahua Hot Dogs, Del Perro -- the SECOND branch; the first is a mile
vendors._note2: and a half east and has had this menu since it was written, so the shelf
vendors._note3: is inherited rather than invented. OPEN 24 HOURS on the glass, and no
vendors._note4: hours key for exactly that reason. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Chihuahua Hot Dogs

vendors._note: TACO BOMB, Del Perro -- the FIRST one in this file, which is why the
vendors._note2: generic taco has been called Taco Bomb Taco all along with nowhere to buy
vendors._note3: it. A THIN SHELF ON PURPOSE: the window carries the logo and the chilli
vendors._note4: and no menu board, so there is nothing to put on it that is not invented.
vendors.name: Taco Bomb

vendors._note: Taco Bomb, Vespucci -- the second one, and a proper branch rather than a
vendors._note2: second door: it is a third of a mile from the Del Perro shop and down at
vendors._note3: beach level. Same thin shelf, and for the same reason: a logo in the
vendors._note4: window and no menu board on it.
vendors.name: Taco Bomb

vendors._note: Up-n-Atom Burger, Del Perro. The second location. Same stock as the
vendors._note2: first, whose door, side door and drive-through all share it already.
vendors.name: Up-n-Atom Burger

vendors._note: Up-n-Atom Del Perro, THE LOWER DOOR. The same shop: it sits four metres
vendors._note2: below the other entrance with the two mascots painted either side of it,
vendors._note3: so the mall has a level each. Same shelf and NO BLIP -- one shop, one pin,
vendors._note4: the way upnatom_side and hornys_side are already done.
vendors.name: Up-n-Atom Burger

vendors._note: LETTUCE BE, Vespucci. VEGETARIAN CUISINE on the sign, under a peace
vendors._note2: symbol, and a room of laid tables behind the glass. Priced with Haute
vendors._note3: rather than with the parade, and there is no meat on the shelf -- that is
vendors._note4: the one thing the sign actually promises. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Lettuce Be

vendors._note: BURGER SHOT, Vespucci. The FIRST one in this file, which is why the
vendors._note2: Bleeder Burger has been generic all along -- it is theirs, so it goes on
vendors._note3: this shelf and stays generic for the 24/7s that also stock it.
vendors.name: Burger Shot

vendors._note: Burger Shot Vespucci, THE SECOND DOOR. Fifteen metres along the same
vendors._note2: frontage at the same level, so it is a door and not a branch. Same shelf,
vendors._note3: no blip.
vendors.name: Burger Shot

vendors._note: Rob's Liquor, Vespucci. ANOTHER WALK-IN, so the coordinate is the counter
vendors._note2: inside again -- half a kilometre from the Del Perro one, so a branch and
vendors._note3: not a second door. Same shelf: it is the same shop with the same Redwood
vendors._note4: rack, the same Logger stack and the same NO ID NO SALE sign on the wall.
vendors.name: Rob's Liquor

vendors._note: Cool Beans Coffee Co, Bay City Avenue. The third branch. Same stock as
vendors._note2: the other two, for the reason Bean Machine's six share one: it is a chain,
vendors._note3: and a coffee shop with a different menu per suburb reads as a mistake.
vendors.name: Cool Beans Coffee Co

vendors._note: GIOVANNI'S ITALIAN RESTAURANT, Vespucci. The sign's second line is the
vendors._note2: menu -- DELI PIZZA SANDWICHES SALADS -- so the shelf is those four in that
vendors._note3: order, with the shared deli sandwich standing in for the deli. Wine because
vendors._note4: it is a restaurant with tables outside, not a counter. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Giovanni's Italian Restaurant

vendors._note: Haute, Del Perro Plaza -- the SECOND one. The first is up in Vinewood
vendors._note2: with the same name over the same red rose window, so the tasting plate,
vendors._note3: the soup and the wine list come with it. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Haute

vendors._note: LES BIANCO, Del Perro Plaza, two doors along from Haute. Fine dining and
vendors._note2: nothing legible from the street, so the shelf is the course structure --
vendors._note3: primo, secondo -- and the cellar. Priced beside Haute because it stands
vendors._note4: beside it. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Les Bianco

vendors._note: SUMAC RESTAURANT, Del Perro. Bougainvillea over a pergola and the name of
vendors._note2: a spice on the board, so it is read as Mediterranean: mezze, a mixed grill
vendors._note3: and mint tea. Door coordinate.
vendors.name: Sumac Restaurant

vendors._note: NOODLE EXCHANGE, the Del Perro parade on Bay City Avenue -- a second branch,
vendors._note2: a long way from the Vinewood pair. Same stock as those two, for the reason
vendors._note3: the Cool Beans branches share one: it is a chain, and a different menu per
vendors._note4: suburb reads as a mistake rather than as local colour. Door coordinate.
vendors._note5: Heading is the PLAYER's facing from the photo, so it points INTO the shop.
vendors._note6: Nothing spawns here, so it is inert -- recorded for whenever something does.
vendors.name: Noodle Exchange

vendors._note: THE DICKIES BAGELS & DELI on the same Del Perro parade, four doors up from
vendors._note2: Noodle Exchange. Second branch; the first is under the freeway at Del Perro
vendors._note3: Heights. Carries what that one carries -- the bagel half and the deli half,
vendors._note4: and coffee, because a bagel shop without coffee is not one.
vendors._note5: Door coordinate. Heading is the player's facing from the photo.
vendors.name: The Dickies Bagels & Deli

vendors._note: COOL BEANS COFFEE CO, the fourth branch, further up the same Del Perro
vendors._note2: parade. COFFEE TEA & CAKE painted on the window. Same stock as the other
vendors._note3: three. Door coordinate; heading is the player's facing from the photo.
vendors.name: Cool Beans Coffee Co

_comment: Doors surveyed in game and NOT YET BUILT. The loader reads "vendors" and nothing
else, so everything in here is inert -- a notebook, not a disabled entry.
Every one was measured against the shipped list and none is within 18m of an
existing door, so building them is purely additive. Where a note says 'same
frontage', those rows are one venue photographed from two or three of its doors
and must become ONE vendor, not several.
